results.Summary: Velomark Mobility LLC (Velomark) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Velomark Cityrunner vehicles. The battery management software may not detect a cell fault.
results.Consequence: An undetected cell fault can increase the risk of a fire.
results.Remedy: Dealers will update the battery management software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed April 10, 2026.
results.Notes: Owners may also contact the NHTSA Vehicle Safety Hotline.
